ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-white cauliflower florets, firm with slightly speckled, lightly browned tips, about 4-5 cm across each, roughly four florets clustered at upper left and top center of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Dark brown roasted cubes with crisp, slightly charred edges and a matte surface, about 1.5-2 cm pieces, piled at the left-center of the plate beside the cauliflower | 90
ITEM 3 | Golden-yellow strips and wedges with browned, slightly glossy edges and soft interior, about 3-5 cm long, mixed with green pepper pieces at lower left | 70
ITEM 4 | Dark green and brown pieces, possibly charred vegetable skins with glossy, slightly oily sheen, scattered in the center and near the top edge | 25
ITEM 5 | Small red pepper chunks, glossy and moist, about 1-2 cm, sitting among the vegetables at center | 10
ITEM 6 | Bright green broccoli florets, firm and matte, about 2-3 cm, at the lower center edge of the plate | 25
ITEM 7 | Mixed fresh green leaves, lightly wilted, glossy with dressing, about 6-8 cm spread at lower right | 30
ITEM 8 | Off-white creamy dressing or sauce, thick and semi-opaque, coating the leaves and grains at lower right, with a smooth sheen | 35
ITEM 9 | Pale tan crumbly grains or nuts with small toasted bits, scattered in the sauce and along the right edge, moist and clumped in places | 40
ITEM 10 | Small scattered crumbs and specks of tan and brown topping along the right edge and top of the plate, dry and loose | 5
